mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'list' = browse/search the public tender-notice listing (newest first by default). 'detail' = fetch specific tender(s) directly by their detail_ref.

detailRefs.title: Detail refs
detailRefs.description: Only used when mode='detail'. One or more 'tendReferNo|tendStageCd|tendTypeCd' strings, exactly as emitted in the detail_ref field of mode='list' output, e.g. "000001/NC/NCB/2026/2027/1207000001|O|NC".

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of tender notices to return. Ignored by mode='detail' (which returns exactly the refs given).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail per notice
fetchDetails.description: For mode='list': also fetch each notice's own detail page (procuring entity, full description, fee, security, documents list, etc). Slower but much richer output.

tenderType.title: Tender type filter
tenderType.description: Restrict to one procurement type. Leave blank for all types.

tenderMethod.title: Tender method filter
tenderMethod.description: Restrict to one procurement method. Leave blank for all methods.

tenderStatus.title: Tender status filter
tenderStatus.description: Restrict to one tender lifecycle status. Leave blank for all statuses. Note: querying 'Signed Contract' returns no data on this endpoint -- contract-award data is not exposed on this public listing.

procuringEntityName.title: Procuring entity name contains
procuringEntityName.description: Free-text filter on the procuring entity name, e.g. "Ministry of Health". Leave blank for all entities.

tenderName.title: Tender name contains
tenderName.description: Free-text filter on the tender name/title. Leave blank for all.

tenderNo.title: Tender number
tenderNo.description: Filter by an exact/partial tender reference number.

invitationDateFrom.title: Invitation date from
invitationDateFrom.description: Restrict to notices advertised on/after this date, format dd/MM/yyyy (e.g. 01/07/2026). Leave blank for no lower bound.

invitationDateTo.title: Invitation date to
invitationDateTo.description: Restrict to notices advertised on/before this date, format dd/MM/yyyy. Leave blank for no upper bound.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent detail fetches
maxConcurrency.description: How many notice-detail pages to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. This target has no anti-bot gate, so a plain datacenter proxy (or no proxy) also works -- residential is offered for consistency with other actors in this collection.
